mapper.select: SELECT TRANSACTION_ID as transactionId, TRANSACTION_NO as transactionNo, TRANSACTION_TYPE as transactionType, TRANSACTION_DATE as transactionDate, BUSINESS_DATA as businessData, SOURCE_SYSTEM as sourceSystem, TRANSACTION_STATUS as transactionStatus, BOOK_ID as bookId, TENANT_ID as tenantId, VERSION as version, CREATE_TIME as createTime, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, CREATOR as creator, UPDATER as updater FROM T_BUSINESS_TRANSACTION WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND TRANSACTION_TYPE = #{transactionType} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} ORDER BY TRANSACTION_DATE DESC

SELECT TRANSACTION_ID as transactionId, TRANSACTION_NO as transactionNo, TRANSACTION_TYPE as transactionType, TRANSACTION_DATE as transactionDate, BUSINESS_DATA as businessData, SOURCE_SYSTEM as sourceSystem, TRANSACTION_STATUS as transactionStatus, BOOK_ID as bookId, TENANT_ID as tenantId, VERSION as version, CREATE_TIME as createTime, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, CREATOR as creator, UPDATER as updater FROM T_BUSINESS_TRANSACTION WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND TRANSACTION_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} ORDER BY TRANSACTION_DATE DESC

SELECT TRANSACTION_ID as transactionId, TRANSACTION_NO as transactionNo, TRANSACTION_TYPE as transactionType, TRANSACTION_DATE as transactionDate, BUSINESS_DATA as businessData, SOURCE_SYSTEM as sourceSystem, TRANSACTION_STATUS as transactionStatus, BOOK_ID as bookId, TENANT_ID as tenantId, VERSION as version, CREATE_TIME as createTime, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, CREATOR as creator, UPDATER as updater FROM T_BUSINESS_TRANSACTION WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND TRANSACTION_STATUS = #{transactionStatus} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} ORDER BY TRANSACTION_DATE DESC
SELECT DISTINCT SOURCE_SYSTEM FROM T_BUSINESS_TRANSACTION WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND SOURCE_SYSTEM IS NOT NULL AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} ORDER BY SOURCE_SYSTEM ASC

SELECT TRANSACTION_STATUS as transactionStatus, COUNT(*) as transactionId FROM T_BUSINESS_TRANSACTION WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} GROUP BY TRANSACTION_STATUS ORDER BY TRANSACTION_STATUS ASC

SELECT TRANSACTION_TYPE as transactionType, COUNT(*) as transactionId FROM T_BUSINESS_TRANSACTION WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} GROUP BY TRANSACTION_TYPE ORDER BY TRANSACTION_TYPE ASC
